canonical_project: T-Systems / Deutsche Telekom Rechenzentrum Magdeburg (twin of Biere cloud datacenter)
notes: Datacenter-Insider (2021-04-26) confirms Telekom/T-Systems operates the Magdeburg data center as twin of its Biere cloud datacenter and that a water-cooled rack pilot runs at Rechenzentrum Magdeburg; Benthaus portfolio documents T-Systems refurbishment work at Magdeburg. Facility was part of the 2016-2018 Microsoft Cloud Germany trustee model (legacy per DE methodology - counted as Telekom facility, not current Microsoft cloud capacity). Public MW capacity not disclosed; no new hyperscale project found in Magdeburg city (method-driven searches 2026-08-12).
